name: google/gemini-2.5-flash
description: Gemini 2.5 Flash is the workhorse model of Google's Gemini 2.5 family, a thinking model released as stable in June 2025. Google positions it for large-scale processing, low-latency and high-volume tasks that require reasoning, and agentic use cases, with text, image, video and audio input. It sits between 2.5 Flash-Lite and 2.5 Pro in the same generation and remains a stable model with no announced shutdown date.
